title: Származás, anyanyelv és az emlékőrzés (Ancestry, Mother Tongue & Cultural Memory)
grammar: Causal & Concessive Postpositions, Identity Correlatives & Narrative Participles in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say where my family comes from, with származik vhonnan.
I can talk about roots with származás, anyanyelv, örökség and emlékőrzés.
I can say who passes on the mother tongue, with átad vkinek.
